violations.finding: Filename embeds a transient cycle number ('cycle-4-') which violates the meaningful-naming convention forbidding generic enhancement / version-style names (-v2 / -v3 / cycle-N). The filename describes WHEN it was created, not WHAT it does. The script's actual purpose is 'Codex render fixtures DOM verification probe for QA' and its lifetime extends beyond cycle 4 of this spec.
violations.recommendation: Rename to a descriptive name that does not embed cycle numbers, e.g. scripts/codex-render-fixtures-dom-probe.js or scripts/codex-fixtures-playwright-probe.js. If the script is genuinely a one-shot cycle-4-only artifact and must be preserved with its cycle origin, move it to docs/dev/qa-artifacts/20260507-142748/ instead of scripts/, since scripts/ is the durable script directory.

violations.finding: ART_DIR hardcodes the absolute repo path '/dev/shm/dev-workspace/happy-dev/docs/dev/qa-artifacts/20260507-142748' AND embeds the TASK_ID. FIXTURE_URL hardcodes 'http://localhost:8097' (dev web port) without parameter override. Neither is parameterized via env var or CLI arg; the script is non-portable across worktrees / hosts even though similar scripts (playwright-login-dev.js) have the same pattern, the existing scripts are exempted because they pre-date this audit. Per Standard 9, all values that could differ between runs/environments must accept a parameter.
violations.recommendation: Accept ART_DIR via env var (e.g. ART_DIR = process.env.ART_DIR || <default>) and FIXTURE_URL host via env var (e.g. DEV_WEB_URL = process.env.DEV_WEB_URL || 'http://localhost:8097'). Default values are fine for the dev-overnight default flow.

violations.finding: require('/usr/lib/node_modules/playwright') uses an absolute path to a globally installed Playwright. This breaks portability — any host without that exact path (or any non-root user) cannot run the script. Standard practice is require('playwright') and let Node resolve from the workspace's node_modules or NODE_PATH.
violations.recommendation: Use require('playwright'). If the script must run with the global Playwright in /usr/lib, set NODE_PATH=/usr/lib/node_modules at invocation time rather than burning the path into the source.
